Each one shows what it would flag. Turn it on if you want those findings.

reasons.AvoidContractions: Asks you to write out every contraction.
reasons.CompoundNouns: Joins a compound noun that was written as two words.
reasons.Dashes: Replaces a typed -- or --- with the proper dash character.
reasons.DiscourseMarkers: Flags a sentence that opens with a marker such as however and leaves out the comma after it.
reasons.EllipsisLength: Fixes an ellipsis that is not three dots.
reasons.ExpandMemoryShorthands: Wants KB and MB spelled out.
reasons.ExpandStandardInputAndOutput: Wants stdin and stdout spelled out.
reasons.ExpandTimeShorthands: Wants min and sec spelled out.
reasons.ExplainLikeImFive: Expands an initialism into its full words.
reasons.FillerWords: Flags words it counts as filler.
reasons.Hedging: Flags hedging phrases such as I would argue that and to a certain degree.
reasons.LongSentences: Flags any sentence past its length limit.
reasons.MergeWords: Joins a word that a stray space split in two, such as to gether.
reasons.MoreAdjective: Prefers the comparative form over more plus an adjective.
reasons.NoFrenchSpaces: Removes the space before punctuation that French typography uses.
reasons.NumericRangeEnDash: Wants an en dash between the ends of a number range.
reasons.SentenceCapitalization: Capitalizes the first word of a sentence, including one that starts after masked markup.
reasons.Spaces: Collapses repeated spaces, which the prose mask leaves wherever markup was blanked out.
reasons.SplitWords: Splits a word that should be two, such as alot.
reasons.TransposedSpace: Moves a space that sits on the wrong side of punctuation, which masking often produces.
